items.name: Proposal Budget Personnel & Compliance Requirements Extraction
items.description: Uploads a proposal package (budget form, project narrative, sponsor RFA) and returns an RA-friendly Markdown Budget Personnel & Compliance Requirements Analysis covering the personnel summary table, trainee summary with mentoring-plan flag, compliance requirement flags driven by budget content, senior-key-personnel document requirements matrix, subaward document requirements, budget overview table, and cost details. Mirrors the source ui-insight/ProcessMapping proposal-budget-personnel-extraction consolidation.md conventions, including ✅/❌ for compliance flags and ☐ for document checklists.

_embedded_knowledge_base.title: OMB Uniform Guidance (2 CFR 200)
_embedded_knowledge_base.description: Primary regulatory KB. For CAS-triggering proposals (typically large research universities with >$50M in federal awards), swap in Cost Accounting Standards (CAS). For agency-specific document requirements, swap in NSF PAPPG Reference, NIH Grants Policy Statement, DOE Financial Assistance Rules, or DOD Research Funding & DFARS.

data.name: extract-personnel-identification
data.prompt:
You are extracting personnel from a proposal package (budget,
narrative, personnel forms). You receive the uploaded
documents AND any KB chunks.

Be 100% accurate. Quote names verbatim. Use null when a field
is absent.

Emit a JSON object with these keys:

- senior_key_personnel: JSON ARRAY of
  {name, role, institution, effort, salary_requested}
  objects. role one of "PI", "Co-PI", "Senior Personnel",
  "Key Personnel". MUST contain at least one entry.
- postdocs: JSON ARRAY of {name, count} objects, or
  {name: null, count: N} when not individually named.
- graduate_research_assistants: JSON ARRAY of {name, count}
  objects, or {name: null, count: N} when not individually
  named.
- undergraduates: INTEGER count.
- other_personnel: JSON ARRAY of {category, count} for any
  personnel not in the above buckets.

## Output

Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: extract-budget-structure-and-triggers
data.prompt:
You are extracting budget structure and compliance triggers
from a proposal package. You receive the uploaded documents
AND any KB chunks.

Be 100% accurate. Preserve monetary amounts verbatim with
dollar signs and commas. Use null when a field is absent.

Emit a JSON object with these keys:

- budget_categories: JSON ARRAY of {category, amount}
  objects, one per top-level budget category (Personnel,
  Fringe, Equipment, Travel, Participant/Trainee Support,
  Other Direct Costs, Subaward Costs).
- total_personnel_cost: STRING. Salary + Fringe combined
  (e.g., "$245,000").
- equipment_total: STRING.
- travel_total: STRING.
- participant_trainee_support_total: STRING.
- other_direct_costs_total: STRING.
- subaward_costs_total: STRING.
- total_direct_costs: STRING.
- total_indirect_costs: STRING.
- total_project_cost: STRING.
- fa_rate: STRING. F&A rate as percentage with base annotation
  (e.g., "56.5% MTDC").
- cost_sharing: STRING. "None" or a description of cost share
  commitments.
- budget_periods: STRING. "Single-year" or "Multi-year (N
  periods)".
- subawards: JSON ARRAY of {institution, amount, sub_pi}
  objects, one per subaward recipient. Empty array when none.
- equipment_items: JSON ARRAY of {item, amount} for items
  ≥ $5,000. Empty array when none.
- foreign_travel_present: BOOLEAN.
- has_postdocs_or_grad_students: BOOLEAN (derive from
  personnel extraction in your context).
- has_subawards: BOOLEAN.
- has_equipment_over_5k: BOOLEAN.

## Output

Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: proposal-budget-personnel-consolidation
data.prompt:
You are the consolidation step of the Proposal Budget
Personnel & Compliance Requirements workflow. You receive
TWO JSON fragments from the previous step (personnel
identification + budget structure with compliance triggers).

Render a single RA-friendly Markdown analysis. Mirrors source
consolidation.md exactly.

## Required structure (in this exact order)

# Proposal Budget Personnel & Compliance Requirements Analysis

### PERSONNEL SUMMARY

| # | Name | Role | Institution | Effort | Salary Requested |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

One row per senior_key_personnel entry. This table is the
authoritative list of individuals who each require a full set
of senior key documents.

---

### TRAINEE SUMMARY

- **Postdoctoral Researchers:** <count> — <names or "not individually named">
- **Graduate Research Assistants:** <count> — <names or "not individually named">
- **Undergraduate Students:** <undergraduates>
- **MENTORING PLAN REQUIRED:** ✅ Yes / ❌ No
  - Reason: <one-line explanation based on postdoc + grad-student counts>

---

### COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS FLAGS

| Requirement | Triggered? | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| Mentoring Plan | ✅ Yes / ❌ No | <postdocs/grad students present or absent> |
| Subaward Commitment Forms | ✅ Yes / ❌ No | <N subaward recipients identified> |
| Equipment Justification | ✅ Yes / ❌ No | <equipment items over $5K present or absent> |
| Foreign Travel Justification | ✅ Yes / ❌ No | <foreign travel present or absent> |
| Cost Sharing Documentation | ✅ Yes / ❌ No | <cost sharing present or absent> |

Use literal ✅ and ❌ glyphs (matches source convention).

---

### SENIOR KEY DOCUMENT REQUIREMENTS

| # | Name | Role | Institution | Biographical Sketch | Current & Pending Support | Collaborators & Affiliations | Synergistic Activities |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

One row per senior_key_personnel entry. Each document column
shows "☐ Required" (literal ☐ glyph + "Required").

Note: Each senior key person requires ALL four documents.
The checkboxes above are placeholders for the SPA to mark as
received during document completeness review.

---

### SUBAWARD DOCUMENT REQUIREMENTS

For each subaward recipient (if any), render a row:

| Subaward Recipient | Amount | Commitment Form | Budget | Budget Justification | Scope of Work | Sub-PI Senior Key Docs |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

Each document column shows "☐ Required" placeholder.

If subawards is empty, state: "No subaward recipients
identified in the budget."

---

### BUDGET OVERVIEW

| Category | Amount |
|---|---|
| Total Personnel (Salary + Fringe) | <total_personnel_cost> |
| Equipment | <equipment_total> |
| Travel | <travel_total> |
| Participant/Trainee Support | <participant_trainee_support_total> |
| Other Direct Costs | <other_direct_costs_total> |
| Subaward Costs | <subaward_costs_total or "$0"> |
| **Total Direct Costs** | **<total_direct_costs>** |
| Indirect Costs (F&A) | <total_indirect_costs> |
| **Total Project Cost** | **<total_project_cost>** |

---

### COST DETAILS

- **F&A Rate:** <fa_rate>
- **Cost Sharing:** <cost_sharing>
- **Budget Periods:** <budget_periods>

## Rendering rules

- Use literal ✅, ❌, and ☐ Unicode glyphs (do NOT substitute
  with [x] / [ ]).
- Bold every label and total.
- Horizontal rules (---) between major sections.
- Preserve monetary amounts verbatim (`$X,XXX.XX`).
- If any field arrives as a nested JSON object, REWRITE
  into prose / table.
- No JSON code fences around the output.

validation_plan.check_description: Verify the personnel count from Task 1 (Personnel Identification) aligns with the salary line items from Task 2 (Budget Structure).

Verify mentoring_plan_required is true ONLY when postdocs or grad students are in the budget; verify has_subawards reflects actual subaward line items; verify has_equipment_over_5k reflects equipment line items over $5,000.
Verify Total Direct Costs equals sum of all direct categories, and Total Project Cost equals Direct + Indirect.
